mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, request_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{requestIp})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM password_reset_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_token SET used_at = NOW() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()
UPDATE password_reset_token SET used_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND used_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM password_reset_token WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
